articles.title: Mexican military kills cartel boss El Mencho in US-backed raid
articles.summary: Notorious Mexican drug lord Nemesio Oseguera, known as "El Mencho," was killed in a military raid on Sunday (Feb 22) in Mexico. His death immediately triggered widespread retaliatory violence across the country. This significant operation by Mexican forces targeted a major figure in international drug trafficking, but the ensuing unrest underscores the persistent challenges in combating organized crime and maintaining stability in the region.

articles.title: Trump's hospital ship plan provokes defense of Greenland health care system
articles.summary: Former U.S. President Donald Trump controversially announced plans to deploy a U.S. Navy hospital ship to Greenland, citing widespread illness and lack of care for its populace. This statement was made despite both active U.S. Navy hospital ships potentially being unavailable or occupied, raising questions about the feasibility and diplomatic implications of such a unilateral humanitarian deployment to the Danish autonomous territory.

articles.title: Why every scientist needs a librarian
articles.summary: Academic libraries often resemble sacred, hushed spaces with grand architecture, akin to places of worship, notes Jane Harvell, director of library culture. This unique ambiance fosters deep contemplation. The article explores the cultural significance and atmosphere of these institutions, emphasizing their role in promoting focused study and intellectual development.

articles.title: Taliban vows retaliation claiming Pakistan strikes killed children
articles.summary: Pakistan conducted overnight air strikes in Afghanistan, claiming to have killed dozens of militants. However, Afghans are burying villagers reportedly killed in these attacks, underscoring civilian casualties. This cross-border military action has significantly heightened tensions between the two nations, with starkly different accounts of the incident's impact and targets. The strikes underscore ongoing regional instability and security challenges.
